title.narrative: Program for the Consolidation of Private Participation Schemes in Infrastructure
Programa para la Consolidacin de Esquemas de Participacin Privada en Infraestructura

description.narrative: Apoyar y promover la vinculacin de capital privado en el desarrollo de infraestructura pblica y prestacin de servicios asociados en el pas, consolidando esquemas de participacin privada y propiciando las condiciones que incidan en la reactivacin econmica tras la pandemia del COVID-19.

Support and promote the linkage of private capital in the development of public infrastructure and the provision of associated services in the country, consolidating private participation schemes and promoting the conditions that affect the economic reactivation after the COVID-19 pandemic.
